subject: Post-demo: clarify token targets, $/1M goal, and per-model split
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightswim.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the demo — initial traffic & budget info

Diego / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning — product demo was helpful. Quick follow-up with the numbers you asked for so we can advance the PoC discussion. High-level:

- Estimated monthly active users: 120k (mostly web app)
- Typical session prompts per user: 2.8 (median)
- Average prompt length: ~45 tokens; average generated reply: ~210 tokens
- Target monthly token volume (approx): 120k * 2.8 * (45 + 210) ≈ 88M tokens
- Budget range: $8k–$18k/month for inference (pilot to MLP)
- Target unit economics: ideally <$12 per 1M tokens during pilot; longer term target $6–8 per 1M if we scale

Model mix we expect to use (initial thinking):
- Chat (main assistant): ~80% of tokens
- Embeddings (search/semantic retrieval): ~12%
- Reranking (candidate ranking for recommendations): ~8%

Open asks from our side:
1) Can you map those targets to an expected monthly cost at Redwood (pilot vs committed)?
2) Which model variants do you recommend for quality vs cost tradeoffs for chat/embeddings/rerank?
3) Any suggestions to reduce token spend (prompt engineering, caching, short-circuiting) we should prioritize for the PoC?

I'll share our PoC mutual action plan doc after this thread — but wanted the numbers in your inbox so pricing/ops can weigh in.

Appreciate it,

Liam O'Connor
Head of Product
BrightSwim AI
liam@brightswim.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightswim.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — initial traffic & budget info

Liam — thanks for the clear numbers and the quick follow. This is helpful and aligns with other media/consumer apps we've seen. Recap and immediate next steps below.

Quick recap of what I read from your note:
- ~88M tokens/mo baseline during pilot (ballpark)
- Pilot budget: $8k–$18k/mo; target <$12 per 1M tokens for pilot
- Expected model mix: chat heavy (~80%), embeddings ~12%, rerank ~8%

Our ask back to you (so we size a realistic pilot):
- Confirm if the ~88M estimate is peak-month or average-month for the pilot window (3 months)
- Share any retention/caching opportunity on the assistant side (fraction of prompts that are repetitive or templated) — even 10–20% prefix cache helps unit economics

Preliminary sense from Redwood: (high-level, rough)
- Chat: recommend a cost-first single-turn variant for pilot (gpt-like 7B quantized/Redwood-optimized) for baseline $/1M; fallback to larger 13B chat for high-quality flows (sessions flagged by signals)
- Embeddings: use mem-efficient 3–4B embedding model for initial retrieval (good quality/cost balance)
- Rerank: small reranker model that runs on candidates (batched) — costs are mostly at inference count not token length, so plan for per-call pricing there

Preliminary pricing mapping (very approximate):
- Pilot (on hosted API, no committed discount): $10–14 per 1M tokens for the chat profile we suggested; embeddings and rerank charged differently (embeddings per vector, rerank per call).
- With a modest committed capacity (reserved) and routing/caching optimizations, we can target $6–9 per 1M token effective during steady state.

Attached: redwood-pricing-template.xlsx (simple calc sheet) and a copy of the mutual-action-plan template — I populated the PoC milestones we discussed.

Next steps (recommended):
1) Liam: confirm whether 88M is avg or peak for pilot months and flag any predictable spikes.
2) Liam: send any sample prompt types or 10–20 sample sessions so our quality team can map token counts and suggest truncation/templating opportunities.
3) Marissa / Monica: can you weigh in on pricing options for a 3-month pilot with a 6-month reserved commit option and give a rough estimate?
4) If numbers align, propose 30–45 minute pricing + ops sync early next week to lock PoC terms.

I'll wait on your confirmation and sample prompts.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior AE, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Thanks for the demo — initial traffic & budget info

Diego / Monica — forwarding Liam's numbers and Diego's initial mapping. Quick pricing stance from my side:

- If the pilot is truly in the 88M tokens/month range, the ask for ~$12/1M is aggressive but achievable for hosted if BrightSwim stays flexible on model mix and accepts a smaller chat profile in quiet hours.
- For a 3-month pilot, we can offer a 10% pilot discount on hosted rates plus accelerated analysis sessions from Monica's team (billing + operations review).
- If BrightSwim commits to a 6-month reserved capacity at an agreed baseline (e.g., 70M tokens/mo commit), we can provide a 25–30% uplift on unit economics that maps into the $6–9/1M target.

Monica — can you draft a quick ops checklist for the PoC (ingestion points, rate limits, observability hooks) and include likely timelines to enable KV/prefix caching? White-glove onboarding will reduce spend during the pilot.

I'll prep a short pricing scenarios sheet using Diego's attachment — Diego, can you tag the HubSpot deal (HS-4821) and ping Liam with a few calendar slots for early next week?

Marissa
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightswim.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — initial traffic & budget info

Diego / Marissa / Monica — thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers:

- The ~88M number is an expected average for the pilot months (we expect +25% in month 3 on seasonal traffic).
- I'll upload 15 sample sessions (anonymized) to the Drive link you shared by EOD. There will be a fair amount of templated assistant prompts (we estimate ~18% repeatable prefixes).
- BrightSwim is open to a 3-month pilot with a view to move to a 6-month reserved commit if the product/ops metrics look good. We prefer an initial hosted pilot with an option to reserve.

I'm available Monday 10:30–11:30 PT or Tuesday 9–10 PT for the pricing + ops sync — either works for me.

Thanks — Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Product | BrightSwim AI
liam@brightswim.ai
